rationale: tabicl_v2 inference throughput on the 12-GB RTX 5070 cannot complete a single walk-forward window inside the 5-10 min train-mode budget, let alone the 7-window gate; keeping it as the active case would starve train mode. Revert to kernel_logreg (iter #1344's 4/7 ceiling at n_components=300, gamma=0.5, C=3.0, pca=32) so train mode can continue sweeping the unswept `calibrate` HP and softmax-temperature grid around that operating point.
